guides.title_en: Alibaba Qwen-CUA: Free Open-Source Computer Use Agent with 397B Parameters
guides.description_zh: 阿里Qwen团队推出原生Computer Use Agent「Qwen-CUA」，基于397B-A17B混合专家架构，直接通过屏幕截图感知界面状态，无需依赖DOM树，在OSWorld-Verified基准上达到86.2分。免费开源，可本地部署。
guides.description_en: Alibaba Qwen team releases Qwen-CUA, a native Computer Use Agent based on 397B-A17B MoE architecture. Directly perceives UI state through screenshots without DOM tree dependency, achieving 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified benchmark. Free and open-source.

faq_zh.question: Qwen-CUA真的完全免费吗？有没有隐藏收费？
faq_zh.answer: 完全免费，Apache 2.0协议开源，模型权重、推理代码全公开。阿里不收费，本地部署只用花自己显卡的电费，云端调用走DashScope也是免费额度，没有套路。

faq_zh.question: 使用Qwen-CUA需要绑信用卡或实名认证吗？
faq_zh.answer: 本地部署啥都不需要，模型下下来就能跑。走DashScope API要注册阿里云账号送免费额度，门槛很低，不用绑卡。等额度用完才需要充值，充值才实名。

faq_zh.question: Qwen-CUA生成的内容能商用吗？会不会有版权坑？
faq_zh.answer: 能商用，Apache 2.0协议明确允许商业用途。但注意一点，模型操控浏览器执行任务时，访问的第三方网站ToS要自己遵守，比如批量操作别触发平台风控。

faq_zh.question: Qwen-CUA和Claude Computer Use、OpenAI Operator比怎么样？
faq_zh.answer: 开源免费是绝对优势，Claude和Operator都要付费且闭源。性能上Qwen-CUA在OSWorld-Verified跑分86.2，比开源同类强不少，但比Claude最新版本还有差距。胜在可私有部署、数据不出门。

faq_zh.question: 本地部署Qwen-CUA最容易踩哪些坑？
faq_zh.answer: 显存是第一个坑，397B全量需要好几张H100，普通人只能跑量化版效果打折扣。第二个坑是截图识别在复杂UI上会误操作，建议先在测试环境跑。最后是API限流，高峰期DashScope排队。

faq_en.question: Is Qwen-CUA really free to use?
faq_en.answer: Yes, the model is fully open-source under Apache 2.0. You can download weights from HuggingFace and run it locally on your own hardware. No API fees, no token limits, no hidden subscription.

faq_en.question: Do I need to provide a credit card to get started?
faq_en.answer: No credit card required. Just install it locally via the GitHub repo or use Alibaba's Model Studio free tier. Registration with a phone number or GitHub account is enough to get started.

faq_en.question: Can I use Qwen-CUA commercially in my product?
faq_en.answer: Yes, Apache 2.0 license allows commercial use, modification, and redistribution. Many startups already integrate it into automation products. Just check Alibaba's separate Model Studio ToS if you use their hosted API.

faq_en.question: How does Qwen-CUA compare to Anthropic Computer Use and OpenAI Operator?
faq_en.answer: Qwen-CUA matches OpenAI Operator on OSWorld (around 38%) and beats Anthropic's Computer Use. It also supports mobile and web, while Anthropic is web-only. Major plus: it runs locally so your screen data never leaves your machine.

faq_en.question: What are the common gotchas when running Qwen-CUA locally?
faq_en.answer: Main issues: needs at least 80GB VRAM for full precision, 24GB for Q4 quant. Slow on long tasks (15-30 seconds per step), struggles with complex multi-window workflows, and screenshots eat disk fast during long sessions.

guides.title_zh: Manus AI免费攻略：每日300积分无限刷新，真正自主AI Agent白嫖指南
guides.title_en: Manus AI Free Guide: 300 Daily Refresh Credits for Truly Autonomous AI Agent — No Credit Card Required
guides.description_zh: Manus AI是全球领先的自主AI Agent，能独立完成浏览网页、写代码、做研究、建应用等复杂多步骤任务。免费版每日300积分自动刷新，无需信用卡，无需付费即可体验真正的AI自主执行能力。本文讲清楚免费机制、额度、使用步骤和避坑指南。
guides.description_en: Manus AI is a leading autonomous AI agent that independently browses the web, writes code, conducts research, and builds applications. Free plan gives 300 credits daily refresh — no credit card required. Full guide with limits, steps, and pitfalls.
guides.excerpt_zh: Manus AI是全球领先的自主AI Agent，免费版每日300积分自动刷新，无需信用卡。本文讲清楚免费机制、额度、使用技巧，以及免费版和付费版的完整对比。
guides.excerpt_en: Manus AI is a leading autonomous AI agent. Free plan gives 300 daily refresh credits, no credit card needed. Full guide with limits, tips, and free vs paid comparison.

faq_zh.question: 免费版的300积分每天真的会自动刷新吗？
faq_zh.answer: 是的。Manus的免费计划每日300积分会在固定时间自动重置，通常是UTC 0:00。积分不会累积到第二天，用不完就清零，所以建议每天尽量用完。

faq_zh.question: 不需要信用卡就能注册吗？
faq_zh.answer: 是的，Manus免费版注册只需要邮箱或Google账号，不需要绑定任何支付方式。这是它相比其他AI Agent工具的最大优势之一。

faq_zh.question: 免费版和付费版有什么区别？
faq_zh.answer: 核心区别是积分额度和模型版本。免费版使用Manus 1.6 Lite模型，适合中等复杂度任务；付费版解锁1.6 Pro模型，处理复杂任务更稳定。此外免费版不可商用，付费版可以。

faq_zh.question: 生成的代码可以商用吗？
faq_zh.answer: 免费版生成的代码仅限个人学习使用，不可用于商业项目。如需商用，需升级到付费版。建议在使用前查看最新的Manus服务条款。

faq_zh.question: 为什么我的积分消耗比预期快？
faq_zh.answer: Manus的积分消耗不完全透明，任务开始前不会显示预计消耗。复杂任务（如构建完整应用、深度研究）可能消耗150-300积分。建议将大任务拆分成小任务，或者先用Lite模型测试可行性。

faq_zh.question: Manus支持中文吗？
faq_zh.answer: 支持。你可以用中文描述任务，Manus能理解中文指令并执行。但建议在提示词中使用英文关键词，以获得更准确的执行结果。

faq_en.question: Do the 300 free credits really refresh daily?
faq_en.answer: Yes. The free plan's 300 daily credits auto-reset at a fixed time, typically UTC 0:00. Credits do not rollover — unused credits are lost each day, so make the most of them daily.

faq_en.question: Can I sign up without a credit card?
faq_en.answer: Yes. The free plan only requires an email or Google account sign-in. No payment method binding is needed — this is one of Manus's biggest advantages over other AI Agent tools.

faq_en.question: What's the difference between free and paid?
faq_en.answer: The core differences are credit limits and model versions. Free uses the Manus 1.6 Lite model, suitable for medium-complexity tasks. Paid unlocks the 1.6 Pro model for more complex tasks with better stability. Free tier also prohibits commercial use.

faq_en.question: Can I use generated code commercially?
faq_en.answer: Code generated on the free plan is for personal learning only, not for commercial projects. Upgrade to a paid plan for commercial usage rights. Check the latest Manus Terms of Service for details.

faq_en.question: Why do my credits run out faster than expected?
faq_en.answer: Manus doesn't show estimated credit consumption before running tasks. Complex tasks (full app builds, deep research) can consume 150-300 credits. Break large tasks into smaller ones, or test with the Lite model first.

faq_en.question: Does Manus support Chinese?
faq_en.answer: Yes. You can describe tasks in Chinese and Manus will understand and execute. However, using English keywords in prompts typically yields more accurate results.

guides.description_zh: 商汤日日新Token Plan是目前国内最强的免费API之一。每5小时1500次免费调用，支持Flash-Lite原生多模态模型，兼容OpenAI SDK，无需绑卡。滚动窗口机制、密钥永久不过期、商用限制等关键陷阱全揭秘。

Get 1500 calls per 5-hour rolling window for free, supporting Flash-Lite native multimodal models with OpenAI SDK compatibility and no credit card required. Detailed guide on rolling windows, perpetual keys, and commercial restrictions.

guides.excerpt_en: SenseNova Token Plan offers 1500 free calls per 5-hour rolling window with native multimodal Flash-Lite support, OpenAI SDK compatibility, and no credit card required. But the free quota policy can change anytime. Full guide covers all key details and pitfalls.

faq_zh.question: 商汤Token Plan真的完全免费吗？有没有隐藏收费？
faq_zh.answer: 完全免费，没有套路。注册就送额度，每5小时刷新1500次，刷新周期一过又满血复活。只要别超额调用，永远不用花一分钱，连信用卡都不用绑。

faq_zh.question: 注册商汤Token Plan需要绑信用卡吗？
faq_zh.answer: 不需要。邮箱或手机号注册就能用，不绑卡也不实名。唯一要注意的是别点付费API套餐，Token Plan入口在控制台左侧菜单，免费额度自动发放。

faq_zh.question: 商汤生成的图片视频能商用吗？会遇到版权问题吗？
faq_zh.answer: 官方条款允许个人和中小项目商用，但大规模商用建议二次审核。日日新模型生成内容版权归调用者，但训练数据和合规性商汤保留审查权。

faq_zh.question: 商汤Token Plan和硅基流动、智谱GLM比哪个更香？
faq_zh.answer: 单看免费额度商汤更豪，5小时1500次是顶配。硅基流动免费模型更多但额度小，智谱GLM注册送4000万tokens但窗口期长。短跑选手选商汤，长期囤粮选智谱。

faq_zh.question: 用商汤Token Plan最容易踩哪些坑？
faq_zh.answer: 第一，滚动窗口不累计，超了不会补；第二，Flash-Lite多模态上限低，别拿它跑批量任务；第三，API密钥别硬编码进前端，会被刷额度；第四，超限后不是立刻恢复，得等下个5小时窗口。

faq_en.question: Is SenseNova Token Plan really 100% free or is there a hidden paid tier?
faq_en.answer: It's 100% free, no paid tier at all. SenseTime literally gives away 1500 calls every rolling 5-hour window forever. No trial period, no expiry, no upsell nagging you to upgrade.

faq_en.question: Do I need a credit card or phone verification to get the API key?
faq_en.answer: No credit card, no payment method, not even a real-name verification. Just sign up with an email and you get a permanent API key instantly. The whole signup-to-first-call takes about two minutes.

faq_en.question: Can I use SenseNova Token Plan for commercial products and client work?
faq_en.answer: Yes, you can ship it in commercial products and charge clients for what you build on top. The catch: you cannot use SenseTime's own brand name or logo to promote your product, and you are on your own for SLA and liability.

faq_en.question: How does SenseNova compare to SiliconFlow, Zhipu, or DeepSeek for free tier usage?
faq_en.answer: SenseNova wins on raw call count (1500 vs Zhipu's typical 200), but trails on context length and model variety. SiliconFlow routes more model families. DeepSeek gives you stronger reasoning but tighter rate limits.

faq_en.question: What are the gotchas and silent restrictions most users hit?
faq_en.answer: Three big ones: the 5-hour window is rolling not daily, so bursts count; some advanced endpoints quietly 403 on the free key; and rate-limit errors return misleading messages that make you think the key is broken.

guides.title_zh: Gemini Code Assist 完全免费：Google AI 编程助手，90倍于竞品的免费额度
guides.title_en: Gemini Code Assist Free: Google's AI Coding Assistant with 90x Higher Limits
guides.excerpt_zh: Google 推出免费版的 Gemini Code Assist，支持 VS Code、JetBrains 等主流编辑器，每月 90 万次代码补全请求。
guides.excerpt_en: Google launched the free Gemini Code Assist for individuals, supporting VS Code, JetBrains and other mainstream editors. 900K code completion requests per month.

faq_zh.question: Gemini Code Assist 真的完全免费吗
faq_zh.answer: 是的，个人版完全免费，每天 6000 次代码补全请求、240 次聊天对话，覆盖几乎所有主流 IDE。不过企业版需要付费，按席位收费。

faq_zh.question: 注册需要绑定信用卡吗
faq_zh.answer: 完全不需要，Google 账号就能登录，连手机号都不用验证，3 秒开箱即用。这点比 GitHub Copilot 良心多了，那货要试用还得先扣你 1 美元验证。

faq_zh.question: 生成代码能商用吗
faq_zh.answer: 能。Google 明确写了，免费版生成的代码归你所有，可以直接用到商业项目里。但注意别把生成的代码原样当开源项目发布，容易和训练数据撞车。

faq_zh.question: 和 GitHub Copilot 比怎么样
faq_zh.answer: 免费额度是 Copilot 免费版的 90 倍，Copilot 免费版每月才 2000 次聊天。代码质量上，Gemini 在长上下文和多文件重构上更强，但 Copilot 在主流语言上更稳。

faq_zh.question: 新手最容易踩什么坑
faq_zh.answer: 三大坑：第一，别用个人版做企业项目，企业版有合规审计；第二，敏感代码先关掉遥测，不然会被上传；第三，IDE 插件装完记得重启，不然代码补全不生效。

faq_en.question: Is Gemini Code Assist Free tier really free?
faq_en.answer: Yes, individual developers get it free forever — no trial period, no credit card needed. The free tier includes code completion, chat, and Gemini 2.5 Pro access with way higher limits than before.

faq_en.question: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
faq_en.answer: No credit card required. Just sign in with a personal Google account at codeassist.google and start using it immediately. Works the same way VS Code and JetBrains extensions do.

faq_en.question: Can I use code from Gemini Code Assist in commercial projects?
faq_en.answer: Yes, you own the code it generates. Google's terms let you use it for commercial work without restrictions, including proprietary software and client projects.

faq_en.question: How does it compare to GitHub Copilot free tier?
faq_en.answer: Gemini's free tier is more generous on usage limits — 90x higher than before — and includes Gemini 2.5 Pro model access. Copilot free is more limited on chat and uses GPT-4o mini.

faq_en.question: What are common gotchas with the free tier?
faq_en.answer: Watch out: standard Gemini Code Assist (enterprise) is different from the free individual version. You also can't use it for coding agents or CI automation — those require the paid Standard or Enterprise tiers.
